text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco celebrates 21st anniversary of Green March of 350,000 volunteers into Spanish controlled Western Sahara.
- External Trade Minister Mohamed Alami heads for Iraq with business delegation, at time of Baghdad's international fair.
- Third vice-president of Khenifra local council arrested on charge of involvement in traffic of illegal immigrants to Spain and France.
- Morocco and Eritrea sign three cooperation agreements.
- Two travel agencies banned from organising visits to Mecca for annual pilgrimage, the haj, and five barred for two years for "infractions" over quotas.
- Sports Minister Ahmed Meziane says Morocco has good chance of being picked for football World Cup 2006, with Egypt and South Africa main rivals for venue on African continent.
